description: Westchester is a Westside Los Angeles neighborhood built around Loyola Marymount University and the LAX flight path, with a mix of single-family homes near The Loop and apartments closer to the airport. Bernardino Martin helps Westchester homeowners and property managers with AC repair, heating service, and maintenance built to perform reliably in a marine-layer coastal climate.
climate: Coastal marine layer with foggy, cool mornings near the airport and the coast, warming through clear afternoons

localLife.nature: Westchester's tract homes went up fast during the postwar aerospace boom, and the neighborhood still reads more inland and suburban than coastal — flatter, further from the water's edge — despite sitting only minutes from Playa del Rey.
localLife.community: A mix of the Loyola Marymount University and Otis College academic community, longtime families in mid-century tract homes built during the aerospace boom, and quieter residential streets in Kentwood set back from the airport noise.
localLife.howWeHelp: We service the original ductwork common in Westchester's aerospace-era tract homes, and we work around LMU and Otis College's academic calendar for properties near campus instead of assuming every week looks the same.

seasonalNotes.focus: Marine layer keeps Westchester's mornings foggy and cool, but clear afternoons still warm the inland-feeling tract blocks enough that original aerospace-era ductwork often falls behind.
A lot of Westchester's mid-century tract homes are still running ductwork installed during the original aerospace-boom construction wave — a fall check tells us honestly how much longer it has.
